description.zh: 暮光加速（Twilight Speed）自 2023 年开业以来，以其全自研 BGP 智能调度算法与专线级出口迅速赢得了良好口碑。其主要优势在于对不同宽带运营商（电信、联通、移动）的精准匹配，有效规避骨干网晚高峰丢包。
description.en: Twilight Speed is a high-performance cross-border proxy provider. Featuring Dedicated Exit / Shadowsocks / Smart BGP, Gigabit Redundant / 40ms Latency, and full support for Netflix, 4K YouTube streaming, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. Starting at ¥20/月.
